newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen mixed to lower in early trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen mixed to lower in early trade.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to open mixed to lower on Thursday with all eyes on the high techs to see whether they can bounce back from a sell-off which undermined the entire market Wednesday.
"The momentum from yesterday carried over into European markets, so I think we will open mixed to lower," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities.
"The key to trading today will be the techs. The market will want to see whether the likes of Intel and Cisco can snap back and show some stability."
